future_check: If a new axis is added, require the strict 30-seed override matrix and ordinary-draw observe_overrides round-trip before merging.
rationale: The baseline declared controls that were accepted but not consumed/observable. The replacement axis set is intentionally small enough that every Cartesian boundary combination is realizable and recoverable from the returned grid.
summary: Use six exact observable numeric axes and no texture aliases.

future_check: Retain a non-pair multiplicity witness in every EXAMPLES_NEEDED sliding window whenever the lesson schedule changes.
rationale: The baseline invariant required every nonzero color to appear exactly twice, silently narrowing the distribution so a fill-every-nonzero-bbox rival survived. Triplets remain unchanged under the authoritative rule and break that shortcut.
summary: Ordinary lessons include non-pair triplet colors so the multiplicity==2 predicate is actually taught.

future_check: Re-measure a larger disjoint census if diversity policy raises the uniqueness floor above the current measured 99.5% medium rate.
rationale: The generator is stochastic over color/layout choices, so two seeds can legitimately converge. Easy and hard were 200/200 unique; pooled variation was 599/600 with four observable axis tuples per band, so this is not fixed-template behavior but should stay visible.
summary: Disjoint stability census had one medium-band input collision (199/200 unique).

future_check: If canonical examples change, re-run the declared CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS and retire any shortcut no longer canonical-fitting.
rationale: All three shortcut programs reproduce every canonical pair, so canonical examples alone cannot distinguish them. Generated counterexample slots simultaneously add anti-diagonal pairs, triplet distractors, and height-2 rectangles; rival claims are verified by the Racket oracle.
summary: The public correlations “NW→SE only”, “all nonzero colors qualify”, and “height exactly three” are not the rule.

future_check: If canonical/target text changes, require selected exact sync and execution parity again; do not promote raw_code merely because it is longer.
rationale: target_code already exactly matched canonical and had the expected rule hash, so rewriting Racket text would add churn without semantic benefit. Metadata now states each task-local source role and execution parity proves the archival text remains equivalent on all canonical pairs.
summary: Selected target_code stays exact with canonical; divergent raw_code is archival executable history.
